attributes.cost_breakdown:
For this project, we request a total of $99,000 USD  to fully develop, deploy, and support the CL Web3 Grants Hub MVP for Cardano Catalyst, including its impact analytics, predictive modeling, and ecosystem engagement components.

Impact Analytics Dashboard - $30,000
Data integration, milestone tracking, metrics & visual dashboard development

Data-driven Analytics (incl. predictive) MVP - $30,000
Model development, training, success forecasting for Catalyst proposals

Open Data Portal - $11,000
Downloadable CSVs, visualizations, and public-facing governance tools

Community Engagement & Documentation. $8,000
User guides, onboarding, Town Hall presentation, feedback loop

Business Development & Ecosystem Integration - $7,000
Outreach, strategic partnerships.

Project Management & Strategy - $8,000
Oversight, execution tracking, QA, KPIs, communication

Contingency & Infra/Hosting Costs -$6,000
Cloud services, analytics stack, monitoring, buffer for scaling needs

Notes:
-We are open to implementing a reduced feature set if the available budget is lower.
-Team Resourcing: Budget supports a core team of 7, the people mentioned above plus technical support.
-BD allocation will ensure consistent Cardano community integration and promote adoption of the dashboard. 
-Contingency includes buffer for model iteration, data API spikes, and analytics scale-out.

attributes.experience:
The CL Web3 Grants Hub team brings together a unique blend of experience in grant strategy, governance, impact assessment, data science, and legal infrastructure. We combine decades of institutional and Web3 experience to deliver high-performing, transparent, and community-aligned funding infrastructure. We’re also supported by a dedicated technical team covering backend, frontend, and UI/UX development, ensuring reliable, user-friendly, and scalable infrastructure.

Marianna Charalambous, Project Lead, Head of Operations
A seasoned Web3 Project Manager and Grants Consultant, Marianna specializes in grant fundraising, and project management. She has successfully secured and managed millions in funding across EU programs, ecosystem grants, and innovation frameworks—ensuring impactful delivery and measurable outcomes.
She previously served as the Grant Program Manager for a Layer 1 blockchain protocol, where she oversaw proposal intake, evaluation, and builder support. Separately, she also led a cascade funding program under a European innovation initiative, managing the end-to-end lifecycle from open call design to fund distribution and reporting.Marianna has also contributed to high-impact policy and research initiatives via the EU Blockchain Observatory, and currently leads web3grants.co—a cross-ecosystem platform for Web3 funding discovery and analytics.

Dr. Androniki Menelaou, Head of AI and Data Analytics
Androniki is a data scientist with a PhD in Statistics  from Oxford University and a proven track record in delivering multi-million euro Web2 data solutions for private and public institutions. She leads the predictive analytics and impact engine powering the dashboard. She brings deep expertise in data driven analytics and impact measurement, ensuring the platform is both technically robust and aligned with funding best practices.

Mariana de la Roche Wills, Head of BD, Legal, Sustainability
Mariana is a leader in blockchain policy, governance, sustainability, and legal strategy. With a strong presence in advocacy circles, she is mostly involved with the impact features as well as advises on regulatory alignment, sustainability tracking, and cross-ecosystem partnerships—ensuring the project’s growth and compliance.

Tonia Damvakeraki, Grants & Impact Expert

Stamatis Papangelou, DLTs, AI & Data Analytics Advisor

attributes.proposal_name: CL Web3 Grants Hub – Impact & Data-Driven Analytics for Catalyst
attributes.key_dependencies:
Catalyst proposal, funding, and milestone metadata access
On-chain data related to smart contract usage and transaction activity
Technical collaboration with Catalyst data team
attributes.maintain_and_support:
-The Cardano Catalyst dashboard will be actively maintained by Cornaro Labs and hosted at web3grants.co/cardano (or cardano.web3grants.co).
-The platform will include full documentation, downloadable CSVs, and open access for community members and funders.
-We will continue evolving the dashboard based on community feedback and governance needs.

-While we may expand to other ecosystems in parallel, Cardano will remain our flagship deployment and primary focus, driving innovation in funding intelligence.
attributes.proposal_description:
This proposal launches the full-featured MVP of the CL Web3 Grants Hub, with Cardano Catalyst as the first ecosystem to utilize its dedicated impact and analytics features.

The CL Web3 Grants Hub is designed to revolutionize how Web3 grant programs are accessed, analyzed, and optimized. Already live as a public good hub, it features a dynamic database of over 100 grant opportunities—updated every 48 hours to ensure accuracy and relevance. Builders can also use our AI-powered grant matchmaking tool to quickly find the most relevant opportunities by simply completing a short form.

While the platform already supports grant discovery and navigation across ecosystems, this proposal introduces a major next step: the deployment of our analytics and impact modules, with Cardano Catalyst as our launch partner.

These new features will enable Cardano to:
-Track proposal performance and delivery with live dashboards
-Measure real ecosystem impact beyond milestones
-Forecast proposal success using predictive analytics trained on historical Catalyst data
-Support proposers with AI-driven grant matching
-Access open, exportable data through a community-facing portal

By becoming the first ecosystem to activate these features, Cardano will lead the way in intelligent treasury management, improving transparency, accountability, and funding effectiveness across Catalyst.
attributes.key_proposal_deliverables:
1. Impact Analytics Dashboard
A live, public-facing Catalyst analytics dashboard hosted at web3grants.co/cardano, visualizing real-time performance of funded proposals. This includes: 
- Delivery status based on milestone completion and public updates
- Impact metrics such as user growth, contract deployments, ecosystem contribution
- Ecosystem-wide funding trends and category-based comparisons (e.g., dev tools vs. community building)
- Visuals tailored for voters, proposers, and treasury teams

2. Predictive Analytics MVP
A minimum viable model trained on historical Catalyst data ( from Fund 8 to Fund 13), identifying key indicators of proposal success such as 
- Timeliness and completeness of milestone delivery
- Proposal category, budget efficiency, proposer history
- Voting trends and funding size

Outputs include:
- A dashboard scoring new proposals based on success probability
- A report evaluating how accurate these predictions were when tested against real outcomes from past rounds
- Foundations for adaptive model retraining based on new data (future round extensions)

3. Open Data Portal
A dedicated portal offering transparent access to Catalyst data, including:
- Downloadable CSV files of funding allocations, impact indicators, and proposal metadata
- Governance-focused visualizations that highlight distribution patterns, delivery rates, and ROI clusters
- Filters and search tools for community researchers and Catalyst governance members to explore trends and conduct independent analysis

4. Community Launch & Docs
A public rollout of the platform, including:
- Presentation at a Catalyst Town Hall or equivalent governance event
- A written user guide and walkthrough documentation, covering how to navigate the dashboards, interpret analytics, and use the AI matching tool
- A feedback loop: Google Form or integrated survey to collect input from builders, funders, and voters
- An open call to Catalyst working groups to co-define additional impact metrics for future versions
attributes.resourcing_duration_estimates:
We are core team of 7 including technical support and here is our 1-year timeline:

Months 1–3: Discovery, Data Aggregation & Early Development
-Data infrastructure setup (for dashboard + open portal)
-Start gathering and cleaning historical Catalyst data (Funds 8–13)
-Define  visual components for the Impact Analytics Dashboard
-Build early backend for Open Data Portal
-Begin feature engineering for Predictive Analytics MVP
-Draft the Docs + community engagement plan

Months 4–6: MVP Rollouts & Core Feature Development
-Launch beta version of the Impact Analytics Dashboard with basic real-time data
-Release first version of the Open Data Portal (CSV downloads, basic filters)
-Build and test initial Predictive Analytics MVP
-Score past proposals, validate model logic
-Internal testing and feedback cycle
-Draft first version of user documentation and guides

Months 7–9: Iteration, Accuracy Evaluation & Community Integration
-Refine the dashboard UX/UI based on internal/user feedback
-Publish Predictive MVP evaluation report
-Enable adaptive model retraining structure
-Improve Open Data Portal with search tools and governance visualizations
-Run first feedback loop (forms, polls, working group outreach)

Months 10–12: Final Integration, Public Launch & Feedback Implementation
-Full launch of all components at web3grants.co/cardano
-Present at Catalyst Town Hall (or equivalent)
-Release final docs and guides
-Deploy feedback loop
-Analyze community feedback, iterate on key features

attributes.problem_statement:
Across the web3 landscape, grant programs have emerged as powerful engines for innovation, enabling decentralized communities to fund new ideas, support builders, and drive ecosystem growth. However, despite their transformative potential, most web3 grant programs—including Cardano’s Catalyst—face a shared set of challenges related to transparency, data-driven decision-making, and impact measurement.

A growing body of research and analysis highlights three core issues that are prevalent throughout the sector:
-Lack of Standardization: There is no uniform framework for reporting, evaluating, or benchmarking grant outcomes across different web3 ecosystems. This makes it difficult to compare results, identify best practices, or ensure that funded projects are consistently aligned with ecosystem goals.
-Transparency Challenges: While many programs embrace open governance and community voting, there is often limited visibility into how funding decisions are made, how project progress is tracked, and how impact is assessed. This can lead to uncertainty among both funders and applicants, and can hinder trust and engagement.
-Fragmented Data and Limited Analytics: Builders, funders, and community members frequently encounter fragmented or incomplete data regarding grant opportunities, project milestones, and overall ecosystem health. This fragmentation makes it challenging to make informed, strategic decisions and to maximize return on investment for all stakeholders.

These challenges are not unique to Cardano but are widely recognized across leading web3 grant programs, as evidenced by comparative studies.

Cardano’s Catalyst program has already demonstrated significant leadership by distributing millions in treasury funding and fostering a vibrant builder community. However, as the web3 grant sector matures, there is a clear opportunity for Catalyst to further enhance its impact by adopting best practices in data-driven grantmaking and transparent analytics—setting a positive example for the broader ecosystem.
This proposal seeks to build on Cardano’s strong foundation, leveraging lessons learned from across web3 to deliver a solution that benefits all stakeholders.
attributes.proposal_benefit:
If implemented, the CL Web3 Grants Hub—leveraging Cardano Catalyst as the first ecosystem to utilize its impact and analytics features—will deliver transformative value to multiple segments of the Cardano community:

Key Features and Benefits
-Unified Grant Database: Aggregates and updates active grant opportunities, enabling builders to easily discover relevant programs and reducing the friction of fragmented information.
-AI-Powered Grant Matching: Guides applicants to the most suitable funding opportunities, increasing efficiency and supporting a more diverse range of builders.
-Analytics Dashboards: Provide funders, voters, and community members with real-time insights into proposal performance, milestone completion, and ecosystem trends. This transparency supports more strategic, data-driven funding decisions.
-Predictive Analytics: Leverages historical and real-time data to forecast project outcomes, identify emerging trends, and optimize treasury strategy for maximum ecosystem ROI

Value to the Cardano Community
-For Funders and Voters:
Access to transparent, up-to-date data on project progress and impact, supporting more confident and effective allocation of treasury funds.
Ability to benchmark Cardano’s grant program against sector standards, identifying strengths and areas for further innovation.

-For Builders:
Streamlined access to grant opportunities and simplified reporting, freeing up more time for development and community engagement.
Enhanced ability to demonstrate value and attract follow-on support, both within Cardano and across the broader web3 ecosystem.

-For the Ecosystem:
Increased transparency and accountability in treasury management, fostering greater trust in the Catalyst process and positioning Cardano as a leader in grant program maturity and best practices.
Enhanced ecosystem growth through more efficient capital deployment, leading to higher-quality projects and sustained network adoption.
Data-driven insights that inform long-term strategic planning, helping Cardano maintain its competitive edge in the rapidly evolving Web3 landscape.

Demonstrated Value and ROI
-Short-term: Immediate improvements in grant matching, project tracking, and funding efficiency, leading to more successful project outcomes and higher stakeholder satisfaction.
-Long-term: A self-reinforcing cycle of innovation, trust, and growth, as transparent analytics drive better decision-making and attract new builders and funders to the Cardano ecosystem.

By addressing the core challenges of data fragmentation and impact measurement, this proposal will unlock the full potential of Cardano’s treasury, ensuring that every ADA spent delivers measurable, lasting value to the community.

attributes.comment_text: I'm a bit hesitant for Cardano to be the first chain paying for the impact and analytics features for this project we it's hard to know how much this will lead to duplicate work vs other existing initiatives and explorers to analyze Catalyst proposals. There are other things in this proposal that I feel could be interested, but the small budget you ask is split into multiple small buckets so I feel there is a risk that each effort individually has less impact than a more focused push to tackling a single problem

Thank you for your feedback.
The budget is structured around specific milestones, meaning we are asking to be compensated only for actual work delivered. This ensures accountability and allows Cardano to fund measurable outcomes step-by-step, not vague promises. Regarding the features, they will not duplicate existing tools or analytics work. We’re very aware of the landscape and, in fact, one of the core problems we’re addressing is the long-standing challenge of measuring real impact in Web3 grant ecosystems—something that still hasn’t been meaningfully solved in Catalyst or elsewhere. Our approach is unique and tailored to uncover what works, why, and how funding decisions can be improved going forward. 

We’ve intentionally requested a small budget—this is a pilot phase. Our aim is to launch with a focused, lower-cost implementation to validate the value of the approach. Once we demonstrate it works, we’re prepared to expand both the scope and the budget accordingly. This allows Catalyst to support an initiative that grows responsibly, based on proven outcomes rather than assumptions.
